purpose: Tune only on validation. Access test once after model and settings are frozen.

split.algorithm: sha256(relative POSIX path) first 64 bits modulo 10

baselines: train-only byte bigram with unigram backoff
train-only conventional longest-match byte n-gram with the cell model's maximum order
train-only interpolated Witten-Bell byte model with the cell model's maximum order
gate: cell > bigram, cell >= 95% of same-order backoff and Witten-Bell, every fold cell > unigram
